svg.title: ARGOS H1 rocket concept - side view to scale
svg.desc: To-scale side view, nose to the right, station z in metres from the aft datum. The engine outline is the true projection of the frozen engine CAD v3.5.1; the N2O tank is a concept with an estimated length; airframe, fins, legs, nose and bays are the ASSUMED GNC reference vehicle RV-1c, not Lauty's design. Not a fabrication drawing and not a physical approval.
svg.text: ARGOS H1 — rocket concept, side view to scale

Airframe, fins, legs, nose and bays = ASSUMED GNC reference vehicle RV-1c, not Lauty's design. Not a fabrication drawing; no physical approval.
